supporting_observations.claim: During the alert period, WS-BCARTER-01 repeatedly connected to the explicit proxy at 10.30.20.30:8080. The available Zeek records show these connections but do not identify the external HTTPS destination or application.

Before the telemetry gap, Firefox ran as ben.carter and connected through the proxy to graph.microsoft.com; Teams also started under ben.carter. These records provide benign Microsoft-related context but do not attribute the later periodic connections.

At 14:10, OneDrive started under ben.carter, and Chrome made successful SharePoint API requests through the proxy. This is consistent with approved Microsoft services, but occurs at the end of the alert interval and does not establish what generated the earlier recurring connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports a collection outage for WS-BCARTER-01 winsec and Sysmon, and for the proxy, from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. This overlaps the alert period.
Zeek connection records during the gap identify the internal proxy endpoint, not the external HTTPS destinations or the originating process.
Consequently, the records available here do not provide process attribution or proxy request details for the recurring connections during the gap.
claims_not_established: The external destinations, request paths, and content associated with the periodic connections.
Which process or user activity generated those connections, or whether any data was transferred to an unapproved service.
Whether the connections were malicious, benign application activity, or related to an approved service.
Whether the scheduled svc-claimsync password rotation or manual job update had any connection to this workstation activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations and any inspected HTTP requests.
Recover WS-BCARTER-01 Sysmon and winsec logs for the same interval to identify processes, users, and relevant process or network activity.
Correlate the recurring connection times with endpoint application logs and, if available, proxy-side byte counts or TLS metadata.
Review FILE-HD-01 and change records for the svc-claimsync rotation and manual job update, without assuming they explain the workstation connections.
